info.title: MyOtherApp Integrations API
info.summary: Events, registrations, check-ins, certificates and webhooks for clubs on MyOtherApp.
info.description: Connect a club's own systems, or your platform, to MyOtherApp both ways: what you do through the API happens on MyOtherApp, and what happens on MyOtherApp is sent to you as webhooks. Guides: https://myotherapp.in/developers
info.x-generated-note: Written from the Integrations API contract of 12 Nov 2026 and kept by myotherapp.in until the API serves its own document at https://api.myotherapp.in/partner/v1/openapi.json.

apiKey.bearerFormat: moa_live_… or moa_test_… (a club API key)
apiKey.description: A club API key, made by the club's owner or admin in Club dashboard → Settings → Integrations. Each key has its own scopes.

partnerOAuth.description: Partner apps, registered by the MyOtherApp team. Authorization code with PKCE (S256) for each club that connects your app; client credentials for your app's own calls (GET and POST /clubs).

scopes.club:write: Change the club's name, tagline, about, links and logo.
scopes.events:read: Read the club's events, drafts included.
scopes.events:write: Create events (as drafts), change them, and cancel events with no online payments.
scopes.events:publish: Publish events, so people can find them and register.
scopes.registrations:read: Read registrations and check-ins: status, ticket, payment status, check-in time. Not names, contact details or answers.
scopes.registrations:write: Register people, change their name and answers, and cancel registrations that are free or paid outside MyOtherApp.
scopes.attendees:read: See attendees' names, email addresses, phone numbers and answers. The club must first confirm its registration form tells people their details are shared with you.
scopes.checkins:write: Check people in, and undo a check-in.
scopes.webhooks:manage: Add, change, test and remove webhook endpoints, and read and retry their deliveries.

scopes.clubs:create: Partner apps only, granted by the MyOtherApp team: create clubs (they wait for the team's approval).

x-scopes.club:write: Change the club's name, tagline, about, links and logo.
x-scopes.events:read: Read the club's events, drafts included.
x-scopes.events:write: Create events (as drafts), change them, and cancel events with no online payments.
x-scopes.events:publish: Publish events, so people can find them and register.
x-scopes.registrations:read: Read registrations and check-ins: status, ticket, payment status, check-in time. Not names, contact details or answers.
x-scopes.registrations:write: Register people, change their name and answers, and cancel registrations that are free or paid outside MyOtherApp.
x-scopes.attendees:read: See attendees' names, email addresses, phone numbers and answers. The club must first confirm its registration form tells people their details are shared with you.
x-scopes.checkins:write: Check people in, and undo a check-in.
x-scopes.webhooks:manage: Add, change, test and remove webhook endpoints, and read and retry their deliveries.
x-scopes.clubs:create: Partner apps only, granted by the MyOtherApp team: create clubs (they wait for the team's approval).
